description: Implementation of QuicCryptoStream class handling QUIC cryptographic stream operations, including frame processing, retransmissions, and stream management within the QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicCryptoStream
classes.description: Handles QUIC cryptographic stream operations, including frame processing, retransmissions, and stream management.

classes.name: CryptoSubstream
classes.description: Represents a substream within QuicCryptoStream for managing individual encryption levels.

methods.name: CryptoMessageFramingOverhead
methods.description: Calculates overhead size for crypto message framing based on version and connection ID.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrame
methods.description: Processes an incoming crypto frame, updating the appropriate substream.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Handles stream frame reception, with special handling if crypto frames are used.

methods.name: OnDataAvailable
methods.description: Handles available data, delegating to sequencer or processing directly based on version.

methods.name: OnDataAvailableInSequencer
methods.description: Processes data from the sequencer, parsing crypto messages.

methods.name: WriteCryptoData
methods.description: Writes crypto data to the stream, buffering if necessary.

methods.name: BufferSizeLimitForLevel
methods.description: Returns buffer size limit for a given encryption level.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrameAcked
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of crypto frames.

methods.name: OnStreamReset
methods.description: Handles stream reset events.

methods.name: NeuterUnencryptedStreamData
methods.description: Neuters (discards) unencrypted stream data.

methods.name: NeuterStreamDataOfEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Neuters stream data for a specific encryption level.

methods.name: OnStreamDataConsumed
methods.description: Handles consumption of stream data.

methods.name: HasPendingCryptoRetransmission
methods.description: Checks if there are pending crypto retransmissions.

methods.name: WritePendingCryptoRetransmission
methods.description: Writes pending crypto retransmissions.

methods.name: WritePendingRetransmission
methods.description: Writes pending retransmissions for the stream.

methods.name: RetransmitStreamData
methods.description: Retransmits stream data for given offset and length.

methods.name: RetransmitStreamDataAtLevel
methods.description: Retransmits stream data at a specific encryption level.

methods.name: crypto_bytes_read
methods.description: Returns total crypto bytes read.

methods.name: BytesReadOnLevel
methods.description: Returns bytes read on a specific encryption level.

methods.name: BytesSentOnLevel
methods.description: Returns bytes sent on a specific encryption level.

methods.name: WriteCryptoFrame
methods.description: Writes a crypto frame for a given encryption level.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrameLost
methods.description: Handles loss of a crypto frame.

methods.name: RetransmitData
methods.description: Retransmits crypto data based on a crypto frame.

methods.name: WriteBufferedCryptoFrames
methods.description: Writes buffered crypto frames.

methods.name: HasBufferedCryptoFrames
methods.description: Checks if there are buffered crypto frames.

methods.name: IsFrameOutstanding
methods.description: Checks if a frame is outstanding.

methods.name: IsWaitingForAcks
methods.description: Checks if the stream is waiting for acknowledgments.
